purpose: Teach: 見舞わ/陥り/放つ/つながら/かけ離れ/一転/産む/傷つける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが病に見舞われた時もあった
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, there were times he fell ill.
lines.style: Soft, remembering voice. Gaze turned inward to an old memory. Slow measured pace, like handling something fragile. Slight pause between clauses, giving weight to each recollection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、戦中の混乱に陥り苦しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — your grandfather did struggle through all that wartime chaos, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, gentle correction or deepening of the memory. Tender but certain — she knows this story. Soft coda on 'dear,' inviting him to continue.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが大声を放つ場面もあった
lines.en: Gran — there were times when your father would raise his voice in anger.
lines.style: Still looking inward, but with harder edges now. The voice carries weight and a hint of old pain. Quiet conviction. Not accusing — witnessing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、戦地と家族がつながらなかった時代を懐かしまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather used to long for those days when war kept him and family worlds apart, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gently reframing the pain into something deeper. Tender but understanding — she knows why he needed the distance. Voice steady, eyes knowing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが理想とかけ離れた現実に苦しまれた
lines.en: Gran — your father suffered when reality fell so far short of what he'd hoped for.
lines.style: The voice slows here. Compassion layered underneath. A long, steady exhale on 'hoped for.' Not pitying — recognizing the particular ache of impossible standards.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、終戦で時代が一転されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather saw his whole world turn upside down when the war ended, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Affirming and bridging — yes, the world changed, and he changed with it. Warmth with quiet strength. A small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お母さんが家で子を産む時代だった
lines.en: Gran — in those days, your mother gave birth at home, carrying all that uncertainty.
lines.style: Voice tender but factual, honoring the women who carried the weight. Slight breathiness — the vulnerability of bringing life into chaos. Slow, reverent pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご家族を傷つける言葉は絶対に仰らなかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your grandfather — he never once spoke a word that would wound his family, did he, dear?
lines.style: Quiet pride here, and love. Voice firm with conviction. The final words are a soft affirmation, not a question — she already knows the answer. Hand reaching across time.
